items.text: If you have a dermatologist you see, call and explain that you’re getting married this weekend. They’ll try to fit you in for a special shot to relieve the break outs temporarily. My dermatologist offered this to me like he did it all the time.
Sophia Jablonski Photography has been awesome.
I bought those too!!!

I’m a high school teacher. Emails from parents about grade issues when their kids haven’t approached me first make me irate. One of the greatest lessons we can teach our children is to be self-sufficient and assertive. Parents of teens need to stop babying their kids.

Now that I’m getting married, I’m just now learning that it’s proper etiquette to send a gift even if you don’t go to the wedding. I’ve definitely never done that. I hope the people I didn’t send gifts to don’t feel like they need to send gifts to me.
I was quoted $1500 for a 2-3 minute video. I can keep all the raw footage though. They’re bringing in a drone and a second shooter.
Hell yeah! Which wine?
Excellent choice
Tony can do whatever he wants
I used Sephora for my makeup—they were awesome!
Wahoowa!
This is cute, but I would always go with the registry or with cash.

items.title: Is it normal to not like half of your engagement pictures?
items.text:
Is it normal to not like half of your engagement pictures?
First thing, my photographer did a great job. I’m really happy with her work.

I’m disappointed  because I’ve lost a lot of weight for the wedding, but I still feel like I looked enormous in a lot of the photos. There are some great pics, but there are some that make me feel down on myself. I’ve never had professional photos of myself before, so I didn’t know if it was normal to be unhappy with half the pictures. Thoughts?

My 7 bridesmaids have chipped in for a bridal shower. I know that two bridesmaids have spent more money and time than the others. My original plan was to get very generous gift cards for those two, and then write a thank you card to the other bridesmaids. I’m paying for all of their dresses, hair, and I’ve bought them getting ready robes for the wedding. Do I need to get something more for the other bridesmaids? I’m starting to panic because the bridal shower is Saturday. Also, I’m really short on cash.

You are being perfectly reasonable. On the other hand, he’s allowed to have his feelings (which I think are a bit unreasonable, but that’s not the point). I think he’s made himself clear. He’s not willing to commit to marriage yet, and he’s not even willing to commit to a timeline. You need to decide if that’s something you can deal with, because I don’t know if he’s going to change. 

If marriage is something you want soon, I’d look for another guy.
I’m surprised nobody has said Maryland. High taxes, terrible drivers, and a ton of crime.

Two things:
1) I am just now learning that you’re supposed to send a gift even if you RSVP no. On the other hand, the best gift people can give me is to RSVP no
2) I need to spend at least $50 per person for a gift
My RSVP deadline is on Friday, and I’m still waiting on 53 responses (90 people). What are the odds I get all 53 by Friday?  #wtfiswrongwithpeople
We’re getting our marriage license today!! And we are picking out the wine!!!! 43 more days!!
I paid $1300 for shine invitations with all the bells and whistles. We ordered 125. I would do it again—you get what you pay for. They were gorgeous, and everybody commented on them.
100% with you on everything, especially the state run liquor stores

I feel you. My FMIL bought a white dress. And my mom is upset because she thought she got to pick “her color” first. And yes, my mom wanted white.
Fuck it, im getting married in 43 days. Neither dress has 50 lbs of tulle and lace, like mine, so I’m just ignoring it.

Drama. My FH has this friend that neither one of us like (he’s in his friend group, though). He has a fiancée that nobody anywhere likes (super loud and annoying). When we announced our wedding date, we were thrilled to hear that they have another wedding to go to that day. They asked us to send them a courtesy invite anyway. I had no plans to send them a courtesy invite (our invites are expensive, and they aren’t even really friends). My FH asked to send one to them if we had any invites left over. We actually used all of our invites (there was an address mixup), so they didn’t get an invite. 

Because we didn’t invite them to the wedding m, we didn’t know how to handle the  bridal shower and bachelor party. For the bridal shower, it was easy. The girl wouldn’t have been invited even if she had gotten a wedding invite. I consider her my FH’s friend’s fiancée, not my friend. She got all annoyed because I invited other spouses of my FH’s friends (I have spent time with them and developed relationships with them. I go out of my way to avoid this woman). This is not a gray area for me. I heard through the grapevine that she’s not inviting me to her bridal shower because I didn’t invite her to mine (I could not be more thrilled!!)

Additionally, FH’s friend is now upset because he wasn’t invited to the bachelor party. My FH didn’t think it would be appropriate to extend an invite to the party when he didn’t get an invite to the wedding. I can see why this would be a gray area, but my FH honestly tried to do what he thought was best. 

Now the couple is super upset to not get invited to our wedding that they couldn’t come to anyway. 

I’m not looking for advice, I just needed to vent because this whole thing is dumb.

I have an obscure suggestion. I’m a teacher, and I have students write on my dry erase board with sharpies every so often. Take a dry erase marker and trace each sharpie line. Then take hand sanitizer and rub it off. I know it sounds weird, but it works every time for me.

I make 50k a year in Fredericksburg (not even really nova), and it’s pretty difficult. I don’t commute far,  and I love my job, so I’m willing to put up with it, but living here is expensive. I’m frequently going to my credit card towards the end of the month.

We had a guest invite people we don’t know. We gave her a plus one, and she RSVPed with two extra people. Didn’t even ask, she just told me one extra person was coming. I’m stunned. Is this normal? She’s almost 70, is this an older person thing? I had no idea how to respond. I was even more horrified because I don’t even know the two people she’s bringing. It’s an out of town wedding (near DC), and I think they want to make it into a trip. This woman was my nanny for 18 years, so she basically raised me, so I gave her the plus 2, but WTF?

Also, my aunt asked for a plus one for her kid’s gf. I know all of this bs is par for the course, I just can’t help but be surprised.
Atlanta! So much fun, and best food in the country.
I had this happen to me twice yesterday. Ugh. People are the worst. One was my aunt, who didn’t bother to rsvp on time. She asked if her kid could bring his gf because “they’re next down the aisle!”
I love being extra, and I wouldn’t even do this. Maybe water before the ceremony, though? I don’t know. Definitely no need for alcohol, though.

I had the same issue. My deadline was last Friday. 76 people didn’t RSVP. We’re calling them all, and we’re telling them if we don’t hear by this Thursday then we assume that cannot make it. It’s so frustrating that people can’t RSVP on time.   I’m hoping that Tax Day and Easter just threw everybody off.

I’m at the tail end of my 6 month engagement. Just make sure all of your vendors are booked. Definitely book your hair and makeup person if you want that, they book up fast. Honestly, I wouldn’t bother sending out save the dates. If I could do it all over, I would have just sent out invitations (we sent our invitations out 2.5 months before the day). Definitely get the bridesmaid dresses going. Your bridesmaids will want time to get them altered. If you haven’t already, get your dress alterations scheduled. And if your officiant requires pre-marital counseling, get that scheduled. Basically schedule everything now. It goes by quickly, and people book up quickly, and towards the end you’ll have so many unexpected things to deal with.

No, I can’t think of anything. 6 months is a perfect length for an engagement, IMO. Once you’ve booked everything, it sort of quiets down until 3 months out—which I feel is the case for most engagements (at least from what I’ve heard). 


Other random tips (feel free to not read :))
Another thing to think about is the bridal shower and bachelorette, if you want those. They need to be planned soon. 
Also, I thought we could skip engagement pictures, and that was the plan. Our STDs were rushed (totally not worth the effort or money) and did not include our picture, so I didn’t see the point. The photographer I hired included the engagement pics in our package, so we did them. I learned so much from them—I learned I look terrible in certain poses, apparently my “soft smile” makes me look annoyed, my fiancé’s transition glasses don’t look good in pics, etc. We also got an opportunity to get to know the photographer, so I think we’ll seem less awkward by the time the wedding rolls around—and those are the pictures I want to look good. Engagement pictures are a great dress rehearsal for the wedding. 

Oh! And honeymoon. Book that NOW if you are going right after the wedding, especially if you’re going somewhere tropical. We didn’t book until 4 months out, and while we are very happy with our choice, we could have had more options if we’d booked in November.

items.title: RSVPs and annoying relatives
items.text:
RSVPs and annoying relatives
Hello! I have an etiquette question. My rsvp deadline was the 19th. I started texting people we hadn’t heard from on the 20th. I sent a text message to my aunt (No rsvp from her or her 3 adult kids) that said this: “Hello! We hope you got our invitation. Do you think you can make it to the wedding? We need to give the caterer a guest count on the 24th.” 

She responded by saying, 
“Hey!!!!! 
Invitations are beautiful!! Will get back to you ASAP! Trying to figure out some things — 
would XX be able to bring his girlfriend (I think they might be next😍- after the other 2 this summer that is ;) Other cousin, YY and one of us probably can’t come because he has mandatory lacrosse tournament”

It’s now Wednesday. I’ve heard nothing. They all got an STD in December. And wtf with her kid NOT responding but still asking to bring his gf?

Anyway, what do I say at this point? I want to be firm that I need to know the headcount today, but I also want to be polite.

*ETA* 
I originally said no to the cousin because of our no ring/no bring policy. My mom got upset and offered to pay for the gf if I said she could come.

As a teacher, thank you. You did the right thing. I teach high school, and so many parents coddle their children. The kids never learn to be responsible! I have one mom that brings me her daughter’s work all the time because the kid forgets it. I think it’s super weird, and she knows that her mom will pick up her slack. There’s no incentive for her to change her behavior (I mark it as late, but the kid doesn’t care.) is the mom going to do that when the girl is an adult?
I sent it to my dad when I first saw it, and it’s his background on his phone. Congrats on the publicity!
Hey! I’m thinking about a Publix cake. Do they deliver? Is there a fee? We were considering one of the chocolate cakes or the cookie cake as a grooms cake.
This is crazy. I have no advice, but I wanted to let you know that I think she is 100% in the wrong. Good luck!

I’ve had several people ask when and where my morning-after brunch is.

Umm... I’m not having one. I’m having a ceremony and a reception. The reception is costing us an arm and a leg, and it will be very generous to all of our guests who put forth effort into celebrating with us. 

Everybody coming is an adult and can find breakfast on their own. I’ll be at the Ritz ordering room service with my new husband and NOBODY ELSE because I am a massive introvert, and I’m not paying for more food  for 140 people (my dad is paying for our hotel stay).
I invited 215. 76 did not rsvp on time. I also had two guests invite other guests!
Me tooo!!!!!! June 1st is so close!
